_about: RECORDED 2026-10-09 from the Prints panels AS THEY STOOD BEFORE Studio › Prints moved onto the ActionButton: `PrintSetDownloads` and `PassCardsPanel` rendered (lazy pieces settled) for six access states — what a customer READS (every word, in order), the Pro door's href and hook, the access line, the go-Pro pitch, the print-ready hooks. The Prints panels hold no price and no confirm step (the unlock page, `/dashboard/<id>/studio/website-pro`, owns both); what they carry about money is this wording and this one door, and it must not change by a byte. Re-record only with a reason written in the commit.
